notes_for_editor: Thin record: no page read describes Imperial's construction history, staffing, fires or current condition. The 2009 map label is the only pre-2012 evidence, and it is a bare name in extracted map text. The layer gives TOWER_HEIGHT 30.0 with no unit (read as metres, per the brief). The brief's 'closed' access and 'no public access' wording do not appear in any page read, so access is set to restricted. Standing rests on the layer's ACTIVE flag. Canada Lookouts has an imperial.html page, but its text carries no history beyond the name, so it is not cited.
